caption: Zaanse Schans, Zaandam
composition: One row of green wooden smock mills along the river Zaan · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the west bank of the Zaan, green wooden smock mills stand in a single row along the far bank at Zaanse Schans, parallel to the river, with dark caps and lattice sails. They are timber, unlike the brick towers at Kinderdijk. It is night, about 20.0°C, under full cloud with moderate drizzle, and the wind is about 12.6 km/h. The river fills the foreground.
